title: Malicious code in @jelou/cli-win32-x64 (npm)
description: The npm package @jelou/cli-win32-x64 version 4.26.1 contains malicious code that fully compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. The compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected computer should be rotated immediately from a different, secure machine. Removal of the package alone does not guarantee elimination of all malicious software introduced by it.
